propositions: signing.py exceeds the 800 LOC hard cap with zero headroom, blocking any new edits at CI
three distinct concerns in signing.py (manifest vocabulary, legacy HMAC scheme, attestation dispatch) must be split along existing call-graph seams into acyclic sibling modules
monkeypatch hazards exist where three tests patch _baked_commit_sha on the signing module and _gate_commit_sha resolves it as a bare global, causing patches to become no-ops after the split

six private-named symbols must be re-exported from signing.py despite the underscore prefix to maintain the existing public surface and avoid breaking nine callables tested by test_reuse_surface_doc.py
the three test patches on _baked_commit_sha must be re-anchored to rebar._signing_manifest and one vacuous-pass assertion must be converted to a positive guard test to close the monkeypatch hazard
